steamFallback.tooltip: Discord has no known Windows executable for this game, but it lists a Steam SKU. This writes a fake appmanifest and install folder into your real Steam library, which Discord scans directly for installed games - but only at Discord's own startup. You'll need to restart Discord after starting this (with the fake game still running) for it to be detected. You'll be asked to confirm the install folder and executable name first. Experimental.
